params.message:
Urgency decides what the worklist shows, not whether a hand may work

kubo-it-lab and menukaart-webapp were refused with "nothing to set: no
open headers task" while three headers of the safe set were missing on
both. A task opens at month; a site that misses only the lighter headers
is judged background, and the gate read the task instead of the
measurement.

It now reads the count the exposure measurement publishes
(safeHeadersMissing): more than none is work this hand can do. Portal
does not learn which headers are the safe set, and a row that is not
urgent still has no button.
